correctness.rationale: Exact exhaustive 313-nonempty-face construction, eight verified D4 maps, all barycentric flags and their orbit enumeration plus Burnside checks produce quotient cells (50,283,471,237). Signed boundaries square to zero. Complete integer unit-pivot row/column eliminations leave diagonal factors 1^49 for d1, 1^234 for d2, and 1^236 with final 2 for d3. Independent mod-two/mod-three rank checks verify the final prime obstruction. H0=Z; only reduced H2=Z/2. The included code supplies all critical calculations; no fundamental group conclusion.

value.rationale: The four-by-four king configuration space is a canonical natural finite chessboard complex. Its full rigid-square quotient reveals an order-two integral class, despite torsion-free homology of unquotiented king complexes and rationally acyclic quotient. The exact torsion from a naturally nonfree geometric action is structurally informative and cannot follow from face counts, Euler characteristic or rational character data. The precise integral invariant is the motivating goal.
